CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting - Conference Room: 2nd Floor
  Alhambra City Hall, 111 S. 1st St., Alhambra, CA 91801

February 14, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

B.  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Nora Hernandez, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai
  Absent:  None
  Staff Present: Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

C.  CONSENT AGENDA
  All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design
  Review Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the
  Discussion Agenda.

  ITEM 1: DRB MINUTES - January 24, 2023

  ITEM 2: 125 Champion Place

  ITEM 3: 1850 West Valley Boulevard

  MOTION:

  o Hernandez moved to approve the consent agenda.
  o The second was by Tsai.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  ITEM 4: 2619 West Valley Boulevard

  •  Request: A new site fence for an existing commercial building parking lot.

  1
   •  Applicant: Jaime Toledo, Karleo Inc.

  •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following
  conditions: 1. The applicant shall clearly state the color and material of the fence in
  the revised drawings; 2. The details of the finials shall be included in the
  documentation; and 3. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB
  Staff prior to permit issuance.

  •  Discussion:
  There were no public comments. The applicant was present and stated that the
  drawings were updated with color and materials. He stated that his property was
  subject to vandalism and that was the justification for the fence.

  Hernandez confirmed that the updated drawings show color and material. Finial
  details still need to be provided.

  Tsai asked questions regarding the gates and the Valley Blvd. exiting. The applicant
  confirmed that the gates had no effect on handicapped parking or exiting. There is
  also a rear gate for circulation.

  Hernandez stated that Building and Safety may have comments at time of permit.
  The DRB concurred.

MOTION:

  o Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1.
  The applicant shall clearly state the color and material of the fence in the revised
  drawings; 2. The details of any finials shall be included in the documentation; 3.
  All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB Staff prior to
  permit issuance following; and 4. All work shall be ADA compliant.
  o The second was by Daninger.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 5: 1429 Front Street

  •  Request: A new fence for an existing single-family residence.

  •  Applicant: Carlos Perez

  •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following
  conditions: 1. The applicant shall update the drawings to clearly illustrate the finish
  and color of the stucco to be used over the concrete block; 2. All wrought iron shall

  2
   be dimensioned and illustrated (i.e., on center picket dimensions, support and top rail
  details, etc.); 3. The fence shall be inset approximately 18" from the front property
  line to accommodate a maintained shrubbery or equivalent landscape; and 4. All
  revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB Staff prior to permit
  issuance.

  •  Discussion:
  The applicant was okay with the conditions but was concerned about the inset of the
  wall due to an existing tree. The applicant provided a photo showing the tree inside
  his property line. The tree starts at the 18” dimension and the diameter of the tree is
  around 14”. Since the tree is at the corner it affects two elevations.

  Discussion ensued regarding the intention of landscape and the viability of
  circumventing the location of the tree. Since the effective height at the sidewalk is 5’
  high they questioned the viability. The applicant stated that he conformed with the
  current planning requirements. The applicant stated that it would likely be lower than
  what was proposed.

  Discussion ensued regarding visibility for vehicles at Electric Lane. It was stated that
  an accurate drawing would be helpful.

  The Board’s concern was the precedent of creating a high block wall adjacent to the
  sidewalk along this street. The idea of using block for the retaining condition and
  wrought iron above may yield a more transparent solution.

MOTION:

  o Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1. The
  applicant shall update the drawings to clearly illustrate the finish and color of the
  stucco to be used over the concrete block; 2. All wrought iron shall be
  dimensioned and illustrated (i.e., on center picket dimensions, support and top
  rail details, etc.) with a max height of 4’; and 3. All revised drawings shall be
  reviewed and approved by DRB Staff prior to permit issuance.
  o The second was by Daninger.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

ITEM 6: 708 Orange Grove Avenue

  •  Request: A new side-yard fence and gates for an existing single-family residence.

  •  Applicant: Joey Curtis

  3
   •  Recommended Action: Recommendation is for approval with the following
  conditions: 1. Revise plans to show that all driveway gates are code-compliant and
  designed to be consistent with the fence; and 2. All revised drawings shall be
  reviewed and approved by DRB Staff before permit issuance.

  •  Discussion:
  The applicant stated that the gates are for the rear only. Discussion ensued regarding
  the location of the property lines and the fence in question.

  Hernandez stated that there were no drawings for the block walls proposed.

  Udani questioned the configuration of the auto gates as it relates to the slope of the
  property.

  The applicant provided verbal information to describe the conditions.

  Drawings showing code compliance as it relates to the vehicle circulation and gate
  swings would be helpful in understanding the project.

  MOTION:

  o Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions: 1.
  Revise plans to show that all driveway gates are code-compliant and designed to
  be consistent with the fence; 2. A detail shall be provided, showing where the
  aluminum fence meets the block wall; and 3. All revised drawings shall be
  reviewed and approved by DRB Staff before permit issuance.
  o The second was by Tsai.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

E.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  We will adjourn to the next meeting on February 28, 2023.

  MOTION:

  o Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:40 P.M.
  o The second was by Daninger.
  o The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Tsai, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  None

  4
 PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 14th day of March, 2023.

  _____________________________
  Ankit Udani, Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
